historicalPackage.rule: Previous D0/Ready records and phase counts apply only to their original architecture; do not restore the old overlay over the revised design.

scope.capture: Ordinary Stop final-message field; proposed local HTTP notification; target build/configuration unverified.
scope.retention: Bounded in-memory immutable session-bound snapshots; numerical limits to select before implementation.
scope.copy: Literal command/code bodies and path-only values; Review for uncertainty.
scope.native: Same subscription-backed CLI and Raw; native questions, permissions and Escape.
scope.experiments: Stopped. No implementation/test/CLI/native/CI/merge/release execution authorized by this documentation revision.

verification.artifactRule: Verify active inputs and candidate fixtures are committed together before publishing documentation. Historical links are pinned to existing Git objects; no local scratch evidence is an implementation input.
